claim: An SQS queue name can have up to 80 characters; alphanumeric characters, hyphens and underscores are accepted. The name of a FIFO queue must end with the .fifo suffix, and the suffix counts towards the 80-character queue name quota.

evidence.quote: A queue name can have up to 80 characters. The following characters are accepted: alphanumeric characters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). Queue names are case-sensitive (for example, Test-queue and test-queue are different queues).
The name of a FIFO queue must end with the .fifo suffix. The suffix counts towards the 80-character queue name quota.
